subject: Animation
title: Toy Story: The First CGI Feature
description: A 60-second lesson on Toy Story: The First CGI Feature.

hook.text: In 1995, Pixar released Toy Story, the first feature film made entirely with computer animation.

buildup.text: For years, experts said computers could never match the warmth and charm of hand-drawn art.

discovery.text: Audiences did not care about the medium. They fell in love with Woody and Buzz Lightyear.

twist.text: Disney tried to cancel the project twice. Steve Jobs personally funded Pixar through the crisis.

climax.text: Toy Story earned $373 million and redrew the future of the entire animation industry overnight.

punchline.text: Plastic toys on a screen launched a digital era.

quiz.question: What was significant about Toy Story?
options: It was the first film to combine live action and animation
It was the first feature film made entirely with computer-generated animation
It was the most expensive animated film ever made at the time

details.summary: Toy Story in 1995 was the first fully computer-animated feature film. Pixar's technical achievement was remarkable, but the film's real revolution was proving that CGI animation could tell emotionally compelling stories, not just showcase technology.
details.whyItMatters: Toy Story launched the CGI animation era that now dominates the industry. Its success ended hand-drawn animation's monopoly on feature filmmaking and proved that new technology serves storytelling, not the reverse.
takeaways: Toy Story was the first fully computer-animated feature film in 1995
Its emotional storytelling proved CGI was not just a technical novelty
The film launched the CGI era that now dominates animated feature production

faq.question: How did Toy Story overcome CGI's technical limitations?
faq.answer: By setting the story in a world of plastic toys. CGI in 1995 could render hard, shiny surfaces convincingly but struggled with organic forms. Using toys as characters turned a technical limitation into a strength — they were supposed to look plastic.

faq.question: How did Toy Story change the animation industry?
faq.answer: Every major studio invested in CGI animation technology. By the early 2000s, hand-drawn features were commercially unviable in America. Studios closed 2D departments wholesale. For better or worse, Toy Story made CGI the default animation medium for theatrical features.
